as_told.title: Nat Kobitz saw UFO technology at Wright-Patterson

plain: A journalist, Ross Coulthart, says that a man named Nat Kobitz told him he was taken, under heavy guard, into an underground room at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base in Ohio. There, Kobitz said, he was shown a piece of a bulkhead, a wall section from a craft, whose material appeared to be bonded at the atomic level, which if true would point to technology no one on Earth is known to make.
